content: HMC5883L (0x1E, Honeywell, discontinued) and QMC5883L (0x0D, QST) are functionally similar but have different addresses, register maps, and init sequences; most GY-271/273 boards sold today ship QMC5883L despite HMC5883L silkscreen. DFRobot_QMC5883 library auto-detects both via getICType()/isHMC()/isQMC(), confirmed via direct source fetch.
